backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining inventory, sales, rates, customers, suppliers, closures, and user profiles with access control and storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend source files.
frontend/artifacts/.gitkeep: Placeholder file ensuring the artifacts directory is tracked in Git.
frontend/artifacts/DEPLOY_README.md: Deployment notes explaining contents of the app-build package.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and light/dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document that loads the React app entrypoint.
frontend/public/artifacts/.gitkeep: Placeholder file ensuring the public artifacts folder is tracked.
frontend/scripts/generate-source-documen: Script that generates SOURCE_CODE.md by collecting and embedding all project source files.
frontend/scripts/package-artifact.sh: Build and packaging script that generates backend/frontend builds and creates artifact ZIP files.
frontend/scripts/README.md: Documentation for the build artifact packaging workflow and required tools.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the application's route tree using TanStack Router and renders the RouterProvider. Maps all major pages such as dashboard, inventory, sales, customers, suppliers, and closures.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthControl: Renders login/logout controls using Internet Identity and handles authentication logic. Displays appropriate labels and icons based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/customers/Overdu: Shows an alert or inline badge indicating overdue customer credit. Supports customizable messaging based on customer name or count.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Invent: Form dialog for creating or editing inventory items with image upload, price auto-calculation, and authentication checks. Manages form state, previews images, and calls create or update mutations.
frontend/src/components/LargeButton.tsx: Provides a styled wrapper around the Button component with larger default sizing. Accepts standard Button props while enforcing a consistent large-button style.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation, global search, authentication controls, and CSV export utilities. Loads key datasets and provides export functionality for inventory, customers, cashbox, and exchange rates.
frontend/src/components/sales/SalesError: Error boundary component for sales pages that displays a user-friendly error message and reset controls. Captures and logs errors while allowing retry or page reload.
frontend/src/components/search/GlobalSea: Provides a dialog-based global product search with debounced input and navigation to inventory. Fetches matching items and displays results with basic product info.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity, initializing access control when authenticated. Invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthBootstrap.ts: Initializes a logged-in user by loading or creating a profile once authentication succeeds.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides a debounced version of a value updated after a delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login state, identity loading, and AuthClient setup via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for inventory, rates, customers, and related backend operations using an actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStaticArtifactAvai: Checks availability of build artifact files via HEAD requests and exposes results through a query.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/csvExport.ts: Utilities to escape values, generate CSV strings, and trigger CSV downloads.
frontend/src/lib/currency.ts: Formats and converts currency values between USD, VES, and COP using exchange rates.
frontend/src/lib/datasetSerializers.ts: Serializes inventory, customer, cashbox, and rate data into row arrays and defines CSV headers.
frontend/src/lib/errorMessage.ts: Extracts readable messages from various error formats, including IC agent errors.
frontend/src/lib/fileToBytes.ts: Converts files to byte arrays and creates image URLs from byte data.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines a large set of typed translation keys for the app’s Spanish localization.
frontend/src/lib/inventoryPricing.ts: Provides functions to compute sell price from cost and margin and to derive margin from cost and price.
frontend/src/lib/salesCart.ts: Defines cart item types and utilities for pricing, quantity checks, and cart updates including add, update, and remove.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Contains a class name merge helper and a simple unique ID generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/CashboxPage.tsx: Displays cashbox balances, lists entries with filtering, and provides a form to add new cashbox records.
frontend/src/pages/ClosuresPage.tsx: Shows closure history, calculates daily totals from cashbox entries, and allows creating new cashbox closures.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDetailPage.ts: Displays a customer's details, debt, and overdue sales with navigation and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/CustomersPage.tsx: Lists customers, highlights overdue accounts, and includes a dialog for creating new customers.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard aggregating inventory, customers, cashbox, analytics, and build artifact info with various download actions.
frontend/src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx: Inventory list page with category filters, low‑stock alerts, and modal form for adding or editing items.
frontend/src/pages/RatesPage.tsx: Displays latest exchange rates and provides a form for authenticated users to add new rate entries.
frontend/src/pages/SalesPage.tsx: Sales interface supporting product search, cart management, pricing options, and submitting new sales.
frontend/src/pages/SupplierDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed supplier information with contact, address, and creation date, including loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/SuppliersPage.tsx: Lists suppliers and allows authenticated users to create new suppliers and navigate to detail pages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, retrieving, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending fonts, colors, shadows, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current state, known issues, and three existing features related to build artifacts and source export packaging.
